title: Bali Package from Delhi for Family
highlights: Visit the Taman Ayun Temple, built in the 17th century, featuring intricate designs with tiered shrines and beautiful gardens, reflecting a blend of Balinese and Chinese architecture.
Get up close with diverse wildlife and enjoy engaging performances showcasing the talents of various animals at Bali Safari Marine Park.
Enjoy the ultimate getaway with one of our best Bali packages from Delhi for family, where breathtaking landscapes and thrilling activities await your arrival.
Take a refreshing dip at Tegenungan Waterfalls and admire its scenery as it cascades dramatically amidst a lush jungle setting.
overview:
About the destinations:
Experience the diverse beauty of Bali with our Bali packages from Delhi for family. Kuta offers lively beaches and vibrant nightlife, while Ubud, the cultural heart of the island, is renowned for its art, rice terraces, and serene ambiance. Bedugul captivates visitors with its stunning Ulun Danu Temple and lush landscapes. The Kintamani Highlands provide breathtaking views of Mount Batur, and the scenic Tegallalang Rice Terraces showcase the island's agricultural heritage. Each destination offers unique experiences, making Bali family packages from Delhi a memorable adventure for all.

know_before_you_go: Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Images are for representation purpose only.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your shoulders and knees covered) when visiting any religious sites and temples.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.

There are no mandatory vaccinations for visitors to Bali (barring the need for travellers arriving from countries with a high yellow fever transmission risk to carry a yellow fever vaccination certificate), although Hepatitis A, typhoid and tetanus are often recommended.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
The official currency of Bali is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Please note that all flight timings are as per Indian Standard Time (IST) Zone.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Kuta | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! We hope you had a comfortable flight. Upon arrival at the airport, you will be transferred to your hotel in Kuta. Check in and relax. After some time, you can set out to explore the city on your own. Stroll through the lively streets of Kuta Art Market and Square to experience the city’s vibrant atmosphere, or enjoy a beautiful sunset at Kuta Beach, relaxing on the golden sands. Wrap your day exploring the Kuta Night Market, before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, enjoy a sightseeing tour of Bedugul, starting at the Ulun Danu Temple, situated by the serene Lake Beratan. Capture iconic photos at Handara Gate. Then, head to Taman Ayun Temple, surrounded by lush gardens and traditional Balinese architecture. Visit a Luwak coffee plantation to learn about the unique coffee-making process. Conclude your day at the Bali Botanical Garden, where you can take a stroll amidst tranquil surroundings. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Visit to Bali Safari Marine Park
days.desc: Board your transfer to Bali Safari Marine Park for an exciting day. Encounter rich wildlife in their natural habitats. Enjoy a safari tour to see tigers, elephants, and various wildlife up close. Watch engaging animal shows and learn about conservation efforts. You can also spend some time relaxing at the park or enjoy a meal (extra cost) at the on-site restaurant. After a fun-filled day, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ubud | Leisure Day
days.desc: Check out and board your transfer to Ubud, the cultural heart of Bali. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and relax. You can spend the rest of the day exploring Ubud on your own. Visit local art galleries at Ubud Art Market, encounter playful macaques at Ubud Monkey Forest or take in the beauty of the place at Ubud Water Palace and Hanging Gardens. You can also visit Goa Gajah, Ubud Royal Palace, and Mozaic Ubud, among other famous attractions. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Witness the breathtaking beauty of Central Bali on a day tour. Visit the iconic Tegallalang Rice Terraces, where you can walk among the lush, layered fields. Next, visit the Tegenungan Waterfall, where you can enjoy a refreshing dip or relax by the cascading waters. Head to the Kintamani Highlands for panoramic views of Mount Batur and the surrounding landscape. End your adventure with a thrilling ride on the Bali Swing, soaring above Bali’s stunning scenery. Later, get transferred to the hotel.
